title: Zempler Business Bank
intro: Zempler Bank is a UK digital bank built for small businesses and freelancers. It’s quick to open, easy to use, and helps you manage spending, payments, and savings all in one place.
body: Zempler Bank is a UK digital bank (formerly known as Cashplus Bank) that focuses especially on microbusinesses, freelancers, and small companies. They’re fully regulated, and deposits are protected up to £85000 under the UK scheme.
Quick online account set-up: You can apply and get started in minutes via their app or website.
Business-friendly tools: If you’re running a small business, they give you things like invoice generators, digital receipt capture and integrations with accounting software.
Real human support: They emphasise UK-based phone support and fewer of the usual long automated waits.
Safe & regulated: Their banking licence was granted in 2021, so they’re operating under full UK banking regulation.

If you’re a small business owner, freelancer or startup who wants banking that works around your life (not the other way around), Zempler may be a good fit. They aim to simplify things, reduce the usual banking friction and give you the support you need when you’re getting started.
**Why choose us (if you’re using our recommendation)?**
Because we look out for banks that:
Understand smaller-scale businesses and aren’t just modelled for big enterprises.
Offer tools that make your admin and money-management easier (so you can focus more on your work than your bank statements).
Provide reliable support and regulation — so you’re not risking “digital bank that disappears”. Zempler matches those criteria pretty well, so strongly worth considering if your business needs align.
